ProjectGu.Combat.GuAbilityDef.label: White Boar cultivation
ProjectGu.Combat.GuAbilityDef.description: The Gu Master sits and lets the White Boar Gu temper their body with the strength of a white boar. Each pulse spends primeval essence and permanently develops their White Boar strength. Stopping keeps all development, and the session can be resumed without waiting.

effectNotes.li: Permanently develops White Boar strength: up to +40% melee damage, +50% carrying capacity, +20% mining speed and +15% construction speed at full development.
The bonus grows with every successful pulse; full development takes about 15 days of regular sessions.
Development belongs to the body. Withdrawing, transferring or losing the Gu keeps it.

limitations.li: One White Boar strength per body. Once fully developed, no White Boar Gu can add more.
Each pulse needs primeval essence; with too little, the session pauses and can be resumed later.
Requires an undrafted, conscious Gu Master. Drafting, another order, incapacitation or withdrawing the Gu suspends the session.
